assertion_semantics.crash is visible: a real web process is started and then terminated; a page that never loaded has no process to kill
assertion_semantics.fresh target executes: targets are discovered by injected script because the engine exposes no host-side target API
assertion_semantics.network request and response correlate: WebKitGTK identifies a resource by URI; correlation is by URI, not request_id
assertion_semantics.provider class is recorded: javascript runs through the engine API, so the provider is engine rather than the mock's injected
assertion_semantics.virtual clock is deterministic: no virtual clock on a real engine; asserted as event-driven satisfaction with an advanced event cursor
